[P2] Isolate deferred export failures from invocation finalization

If an unvisited completion's first export raises during this drain, execution exits before processing subsequent completions or ending the Invocation and Workflow spans. The enclosing `finally` clears the pending maps, while core contains the hook exception, so a successful handler loses otherwise exportable telemetry—even when the processor fails only once. InvocationOtelPlugin has the same failure path. Continue draining after individual export failures and ensure invocation/workflow finalization still runs before reporting errors. Add a regression where the first export attempt fails during invocation End.
